name: SPARC Robotics Certificate Program (University of Maryland)
org: Maryland Robotics Center, University of Maryland
what_you_do: Take a three week robotics session. You need no robotics experience. It is for commuters. Topics include drones and 3D nanoprinting. Others are autonomous ground vehicles and soft medical robotics. You earn a non-credit SPARC certificate.
who_can_apply: Current 10th, 11th and 12th graders. You should be strong in school, like robotics and show initiative. You need a high school transcript and a resume to apply.
pay_detail: The Summer 2026 price was $5,000 for one 3 week session (project materials and activities; lunch and transportation are not included). The 2027 price is not posted. A limited number of need based scholarships are available, and payments are not refundable.
duration: Three weeks, Monday to Friday, 9:00 a.m. to 3:30 p.m. Summer 2027: Session 1 July 6 to 23, Session 2 July 26 to August 13. You enroll in one session.
deadline_text: Application deadline: December 1, 2026. The 2027 topics will be announced soon.
how_to_apply: Use the online application linked from the SPARC page (Apply Now). Include your high school transcript and resume. A parent or other authorized adult must sign you in and out each day. Contact: robotics-sparc@umd.edu.
notes: Very expensive and commuter only. Participation does not guarantee admission to UMD. The page banner says Apply Now with a December 1, 2026 deadline, but another line says applications for 'this summer' are closed, so confirm the application is open before you plan around it.
